Results seen before registration: the v1 XE grid (all 2268 records), the A3 check (51 records) and the A3 result; the A6 check set below is a fresh seeded set (no A3 check case among the seeded members) plus the A3 failure cases named as mandatory members; no case was chosen by its v1 or A3 outcome except the mandatory A3 failure cases, which are included because they failed

numerics_ladder.bridge_axes: bridge_lib.jl run_case exposes four numerical fields: cells (EvenGrid), dt_s, duration_s, average_start_s. Under the pinned solver's adaptive stepping (SimParams adaptive = true, CFL 0.799; checked on the installed package, A3 solver_timestepping_basis) the effective step is CFL-limited by the cell size; dt_s is the escape-hatch step only. CFL and num_save are not exposed and are not changed.

levels.L0: v1 numerics: cells_v1 = ceil(domain_m / 5e-4), dt_s 5e-9, duration_v1 = 2e-3 x max(1, domain_m / 0.1), average from duration / 2
levels.L1: cells 2 x cells_v1, dt_s 5e-9 / 2, duration_v1, average from duration_v1 / 2
levels.L2: cells 4 x cells_v1, dt_s 5e-9 / 4, duration_v1, average from duration_v1 / 2
levels.L3: cells 8 x cells_v1, dt_s 5e-9 / 8, duration_v1, average from duration_v1 / 2 (study only: the finer reference of L2)
levels.LkD (k = 0, 1, 2): level Lk with duration 2 x duration_v1 and average from duration_v1 (the same 50 % discard)

numerics_ladder.applied_uniformly: every axis change is applied identically to every case; nothing physical changes

check_set_rule: seeded: one case per hardware configuration (geometry x B shape, the 14 v1 configurations in v1 order); B_peak = [BP-LO, BP-HI][pick(SEED|XE|geometry|shape|B_peak, 2)], V_d = [VD-180, VD-265, VD-350][pick(...|V_d, 3)], mdot = [MF-LO, MF-MID, MF-HI][pick(...|mdot, 3)], transport = [sgb-screen-01..09][pick(...|transport, 9)], with pick(text, n) = first 8 bytes of sha256(text) as a big-endian u64, mod n, and ... = SEED|XE|geometry|shape
mandatory: every A3 check case with at least one failing A3 comparison (8 cases; they include the three A3 status flips and the 209 % thrust case)
no seeded case coincides with an A3 check case (checked at registration)
convergence_study.runs: 22 cases x 7 numerics (L0, L1, L2, L3, L0D, L1D, L2D) = 154 runs through the pinned run_case (vacuum), threads / BLAS 1, every run recording the v1 per-record provenance plus the A6 level, the v1 key and the v1 case sha256; Rust launch with sidecars; frozen before scoring; scored once
convergence_study.comparisons: for k = 0, 1, 2: G(k) = Lk against L(k+1) (spatial / CFL step), D(k) = Lk against LkD (duration and averaging window)
convergence_study.criteria: as A3 for every comparison: C-STATUS (v1 run status identical; a missing run is NUMERICAL_FAILURE), C-QUIET (quiet class Id_rms_rel < 0.5 identical when both runs are numerically valid), C-T and C-ID (when the coarser run is PASS: relative thrust and I_d changes <= 0.02; P_d = I_d V_d inherits C-ID). No margin tier
convergence_study.level_passes: Pass(k) iff every check case passes every criterion in G(k) and in D(k)
convergence_study.diagnostic_observed_order: report only, per case and observable (thrust_N, discharge_current_A) with PASS at L0, L1, L2 (and L1, L2, L3): observed order p = log2(|f(L1) - f(L0)| / |f(L2) - f(L1)|) (and the next triple), Richardson estimate f(L2) + (f(L2) - f(L1)) / (2^p - 1), and the relative distance of the production-level value from it; undefined (null, with reason) when a difference is zero or the order is not positive. Never used for the production rule

production_rule.rule: the production level is the coarsest k in {0, 1, 2} with Pass(k)
production_rule.stop: if no k in {0, 1, 2} passes, the A6 grid is NOT run: XE stays NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED (v1 + A3) and the result is reported as a finding (STOP)
production_rule.fixed_before_grid: the production level is fixed from the scored study before any A6 grid run; it is never changed after an A6 grid result is seen

grid.cases: the 2268 v1 XE cases (same keys, transport set, geometry, B(z) registration and operating points), each at the production-level numerics; no case dropped, none rerun
grid.case_file: cases/h1_parametric_envelope_a6_xe_grid_v1.json, Rust-generated from the frozen v1 case file after the study is scored (only the numerical fields change; key = v1 key + |A6-L<k>; v1_key and v1_case_sha256 carried)
grid.run: the same driver path as the study (h1_envelope_a6_driver.jl), Rust launch with sidecars, threads / BLAS 1, resumable shards; frozen (gzip JSONL + manifest + SHA256SUMS) before ingestion
grid.run_status: the v1 rule (NUMERICAL_FAILURE > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > NOT_SUSTAINED > PASS); Xe never OUT_OF_DOMAIN
grid.labels: every A6 point carries the v1 XE labels with NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY_NOT_VERIFIED_FOR_H1 replaced by NUMERICS_A6_STUDY_CONVERGED_L<k> (a sampled study, not a per-point proof; EC-NUM stays listed citing the A6 study result); the A3 overlay does not apply to A6 records (A3 governs the v1 numerics)

functional_test.problem: the v1 XE_FUNC test (PASS and T > 0) counts degenerate discharges: v1 PASS records exist with thrust ~1e-18 N and I_d ~1e-16 A (the bridge sustained flag is relative)

a6_xe_tests.HALL_XE_T12_AT_PBUS: PASS and thrust_N >= HC-01 (engineering_constraints_v1 thrust_sustained_min_mN x 1e-3, read through abep-config Thresholds by the assessment layer) and P_bus_fav = discharge_power_W + P_nonHall,LB < HC-03
a6_xe_tests.HALL_XE_T25_CAPABILITY_AT_PBUS: PASS and thrust_N >= HC-02 (thrust_capability_mN x 1e-3) and P_bus_fav < HC-03

functional_test.basis: HC-01 and HC-02 are the only registered thrust requirements (RFP 12 / 25 mN); no Xe-specific thrust requirement or relaxation is registered, so none is invented. A discharge meeting HC-01 is non-degenerate by construction. Physics stays raw (the envelope records carry no threshold); the thresholds are applied only by the assessment layer
functional_test.hardware_consistency: as A1 for AIR: XE_CONTINGENCY needs both tests to close on one hardware configuration (geometry, B shape); any B_peak, V_d, mdot and transport may be used per test

classification_feed.harness: abep-assess harness v2 (addendum A2). With an A6 XE envelope supplied (separately from the v1 envelope), the XE_CONTINGENCY Hall constraints are HALL_XE_T12_AT_PBUS and HALL_XE_T25_CAPABILITY_AT_PBUS over the A6 points, replacing HALL_XE_FUNCTIONAL_AT_PBUS (the v1 envelope stays reported, labelled A3_NOT_ADEQUATE, and has no classification role while an A6 envelope is supplied)
classification_feed.constraint_status: per test as v1: CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE if some A6 point passes (eligible for SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS with EC-TRANSPORT, EC-BZ, EC-DIV, EC-NUM citing the A6 study, EC-GEOM); NON_CLOSING_IN_ENVELOPE if none passes and every point is evaluated physics (never eligible for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING: SOURCED_SURROGATE B(z)); NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE otherwise (NUMERICAL_FAILURE points are unknowns); both tests closing but on no common hardware -> NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE with HALL_NO_COMMON_HARDWARE
classification_feed.c0_c4: C0..C4 unchanged (v1 classification procedure as run by harness v2): the A6 XE Hall constraints enter the per-state XE_CONTINGENCY evaluation exactly where HALL_XE_FUNCTIONAL_AT_PBUS entered, joint with the non-Hall constraints at one hardware configuration; AIR_PRIMARY is unaffected

ingestion: a separate frozen version: its own raw-manifest schema (np_hall_parametric_envelope_a6_raw_manifest_v1), case file, launch manifest and lock pins; every record checked (case sha256 of the A6 case, HallThruster commit, A6 lock, A6 case-file sha256, v1 key); a complete family or MODEL_ERROR; the v1 envelope is never modified or mixed
change_control: any change to the ladder, check set, criteria, production rule, grid, functional test or classification feed after this lock is a new, dated addendum registered before the runs it governs
